subject: Babci's Pierogies
overview: Host Danielle Balocca interviewed Medford business owner Tara Gearheart about her startup Babci's Pierogies, its family heritage, and its local philanthropic initiatives.

items.title: Introduction and Favorite Local Eats
items.summary: Tara Gearheart introduced herself and shared her favorite Medford restaurants, highlighting Bocelli's and Alta Cooper.

items.title: The History and Recipe of Babci's Pierogies
items.summary: Gearheart detailed how the business originated from a century-old Polish recipe passed down by her husband's late grandmother, Babci.

items.title: Community Philanthropy and Scholarships
items.summary: Gearheart discussed her "Pierogies for a Purpose" initiative, which supports local churches, and her marketing firm's scholarship program for Medford seniors.

items.title: Product Ordering and Growth Strategy
items.summary: Gearheart explained the online ordering process, local pickup logistics in Stoneham, and long-term plans to scale operations and offer shipping.
